title: The Nights an Occupancy Supplement Covers on a Hotel Rate Plans Reservation
content:
The nights an occupancy supplement on a Hotel Rate Plans reservation is charged for turn on how far the folio's room lines have run and on where the reservation record stands.

**The nights of the stay already covered on the folio are taken as the highest night sequence the folio's room lines carry.**

## Basis of the count

1. Where the nights of the stay already covered on the folio are fewer than the nights the reservation covers and the reservation stands at checked in, the supplement is charged for the nights already covered.
2. Where the nights already covered are fewer than the nights the reservation covers and the reservation stands at checked out, the supplement is charged for every night the reservation covers.
3. In every other case the supplement is charged for every night the reservation covers.

## Standing by standing

| Nights already covered on the folio | Reservation record stands at | Nights the supplement is charged for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| fewer than the nights the reservation covers | checked in | the nights already covered |
| fewer than the nights the reservation covers | checked out | every night the reservation covers |
| fewer than the nights the reservation covers | any other standing | every night the reservation covers |
| equal to or beyond the nights the reservation covers | any standing | every night the reservation covers |

Only a guest still in house, on a folio whose room lines have not yet reached the whole stay, is charged for less than the whole stay.

## Applied to hypothetical figures

A reservation covering 5 nights, whose room lines on the folio carry a highest night sequence of 3, so 3 nights already covered:

- Standing at checked in, the supplement is charged for 3 nights.
- Standing at checked out, the supplement is charged for 5 nights.
- Where the folio's room lines carried a highest night sequence of 5, the nights already covered would not be fewer than the 5 the reservation covers, and the supplement would be charged for 5 nights whatever the standing.
